utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive! I keep meaning to fix my leaky faucet — maybe I'll finally get around to it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yeah, the one at the community center! They're taking broken appliances and household items. I'm sure they can help with your faucet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the community center! I'll have to check my calendar—this week's been a blur.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Quinn! We're all set for Saturday at 9 AM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Sam! I'll let everyone know we're gathering there first before heading to Mr. Henderson's.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, sounds like a plan! I'll bring extra boxes and some blankets to wrap things up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Morning, Tess. Got everything set for the repair drive starting at 9.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Leo, I'm so glad you asked! I just talked to the Smiths, and they're bringing their old lawnmower, plus Jerry swears that drive can fix anything—even if he once thought his car could fly!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. Let's focus on the fence first, then deal with whatever else shows up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Rosa, have you heard? The repair drive's really taken off—folks are dropping off stuff left and right at Bob's garage.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That's fantastic news, Ira! I knew once the word got out, our neighbors would really step up—this is going to be such a rewarding day for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I'm glad it's working out so well. I was thinking about swinging by Bob's later to see if they need any extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina! Right, the repair drive... I think I had a list somewhere, but I might've left it in my other jacket. Did you bring any notes?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I've got the basics down—tools at the community center at 10. Are you going to need me to bring anything extra for you?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, extra things? Let me think... I usually bring my own screwdriver, but I might have left it at my sister's place last week. Could you remind me if I need a spare?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I think I finally have it straight — Bob's garage for broken electronics, right? Maybe I'll bring that lamp over later.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, Bob's garage? Are you sure that's actually happening? I haven't seen any flyers or official word about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I thought Ira mentioned it was at Bob's garage... but maybe I got that mixed up too? I'm not always the best with details.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, are you planning to join the repair drive on Saturday? We could use another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Absolutely, I'll be there. Let's make sure we have a clear list of what needs fixing before we start — saves time and head scratching.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great idea, Eli! I've actually jotted down a few things already — the step, a loose shutter, and that leaky faucet.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, you bet! My truck's loaded with gear—just say the word if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, sounds good. I'll probably just bring a toaster that's on the fritz.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: A toaster, huh? I've got a multimeter in the glovebox—we'll have that thing popping again in no time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey, sorry I'm late. What's this about a repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Dane! We're organizing a community repair drive this Saturday to fix up old bikes and lawnmowers. Should be done by noon, so I can still make the school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh sweet, I've got a busted toaster—think they'd take a look at it?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks for helping me sort through all this, Hana. I think we're on track now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Of course, Rey. Let me just double-check we've got those sturdy boxes Sam mentioned—I want to make sure nothing fragile gets jostled.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, right—those boxes. Sam texted me the brand, I'll grab it from my phone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'm about to check the drive's available space. Can you help me list what we need to back up?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I've got a list of spare parts and tools in my garage—should I bring those along or just stick to data backups?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Data backups are my main concern, but if those parts and tools are essential, we can note them down too. Let's start with the digital files first—do you have a rough size estimate for those?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: So, Mara, you know about the repair drive this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center, right? We're fixing up old appliances for folks who need help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, I think there's a mix-up—the repair drive starts at 9 AM, and we're meeting at Elm Street to fix the fence first. Can you join us there?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No, no, it's definitely 10 AM at the community center for the repair drive—Noah's already bringing his toaster! Maybe you're thinking of a different event?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Bo! Right, the repair drive. I think I had a note about it somewhere... maybe in my other jacket?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I think Rosa mentioned it. Saturday, right? Got any idea what we're actually supposed to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday? Let me think... I have a feeling it's tools or something? Or maybe canned goods? I should really write these things down.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh wait, I think I mixed up—Quinn says it's at Mr. Henderson's place, not the community center. Sorry about that!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: No worries, thanks for checking. I'll make sure the supplies go to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, thanks Rey! I'll see you there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, I'll have snacks ready just in case. Have you heard if the Johnsons are bringing their tools yet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Not yet, but I'm planning to swing by their place after I finish up here—I'll make sure they know what's needed!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, that would be great, Quinn! If you can catch them, let them know we're starting at 8 sharp—I'll have coffee ready.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, that sounds great! I've got an old toaster that's been acting up—can I bring that along?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, bring the toaster! And just to confirm again, it's this Saturday at 10 AM at the community center. See you there!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 10, got it. I'll try to remember, but you know how it is—my brain's been like a sieve lately.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Dane, I saw you've been helping with the repair drive too—need me to grab anything extra from the store while I'm out?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, yeah, thanks! Could you grab some extra extension cords? My toaster's cord is fried, and I wanna make sure they can test it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, extension cords—got it. I'll pick up a couple of those along with the lumber for Rey.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Cleo, I've got some extra tools and boxes ready for the repair drive. Need me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I think I've got a stash of spare parts in my garage that could come in handy—want me to sort through them and bring what's useful?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That'd be great, Cleo! I can swing by later and help you sort through them if you'd like.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure about that? Jerry's not exactly the most reliable source around here.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I know, honey—but can you blame me for hoping? Besides, we've got a good group coming this weekend, so even if Jerry's story is a little far-fetched, the drive'll still be worth it!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Well, I guess I'll believe it when I see it, but I'll be there this weekend to make sure nothing's getting exaggerated.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It's so great to see you, Gus! I'm coordinating the repair drive for Saturday—do you have any items you'd like to bring in for fixing?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rosa! I've got the truck packed with tools folks can borrow, but I could use a hand sorting through the donations if you need me to help organize.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be fantastic, Gus! I could really use your help sorting through the items. Let's meet at the community center at 9 AM on Saturday to get everything set up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, are you planning to bring your own tools to the repair drive, or should I bring extra?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I think Gus has a lot of tools, but extra ones are always welcome! I'll ask him what he's bringing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, let me know what Gus says so we don't double up on anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great to hear! I've got a broken lamp I've been meaning to bring by, just wasn't sure if they'd take it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds like just the kind of thing they might need. Do you know if the lamp needs any special parts, like a new switch or wiring?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I'm not really sure—it just stopped working one day. I figured someone who knows about these things could take a look.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, once you see the space, I'll tally up the file sizes from my old systems.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I'll go grab the drive and check its properties now; you work on that list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, I'll start jotting down the file sizes from my old systems while you check the drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Uli! Glad you're here. We're starting at 9 sharp on Elm Street — I've got Leo and Sam ready, so we should have that fence fixed in no time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there at nine, then. See you on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Uli! I'll make sure there's a spot for your tools — we're planning to tackle the fence first, then maybe some loose shutters on Maple.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
